steps: What her food already gives her
engine_order.confirmed: This is the engine's own order. Scoring runs BEFORE the safety checks: every product in the catalogue is scored against her answers, and the checks then remove from that scored pool, which is why the removed products below all carry a score.

customer.name: Isabel
customer.goals: Sleep, Heart Health, Bone & Joint Health
customer.health_score_note: The health score is part of the real customer report, which is why it appears here.

catalogue.note: The on-disk Blend demo catalogue. Its three QA placeholder entries carry no safety data, are never recommendable, and are excluded from every count and list here.

lines.question: Do any of the following dietary preferences or restrictions apply to you?
lines.changes: Removes animal-derived products and shifts the modelled plate towards fish, dairy and plants.

lines.question: How often do you eat fish and seafood?
lines.changes: Drives the modelled intake of EPA and DHA, the omega-3 fats that matter for her heart goal.

lines.question: How often do you eat dairy products?
lines.changes: Drives the modelled calcium and iodine intake.

lines.question: How often do you eat vegetables and legumes?
lines.changes: Low vegetable intake pulls down potassium, folate and fibre.

lines.question: What meals and snacks do you usually eat throughout the day?
lines.changes: Meal pattern and portion size set the total daily food mass, which sets every nutrient level.

lines.question: What size are your usual portions?
lines.changes: Portion size scales that same daily food mass.

lines.question: Let's discuss your weekly eating habits. Which description fits you best?
lines.answer: Mixed diet with balanced and processed foods
lines.changes: Shifts the balance of the modelled plate between whole and processed foods.

lines.question: Excluding sports or workouts, how active is your daily routine?
lines.changes: Sets the energy requirement, and with it the protein and macro targets.

lines.question: Do you currently smoke or use nicotine products?
lines.changes: Removes beta-carotene products outright and raises the vitamin C requirement.

lines.question: On an average night, how many hours do you sleep?
lines.changes: Five to six hours triggers the same stimulant block as a sleep goal, on its own.

lines.question: How many drinks other than water do you have on a typical day?
lines.changes: Four drinks a day, taken as coffee, shifts the modelled beverage composition.

lines.question: How much sun exposure do you usually get?
lines.changes: Adjusts the vitamin D requirement for sun exposure.

lines.question: How many alcoholic drinks do you have per week?
lines.changes: Enters the modelled plate as alcohol and energy.

lines.question: Select all the medical conditions that apply
lines.changes: Removes products contraindicated in cardiovascular disease, and raises her omega-3 target above the general adult figure.

lines.question: Select all the prescription medications that apply
lines.changes: Removes every product that cannot be taken with blood-pressure medication.

lines.question: Are you currently pregnant or breastfeeding?
lines.changes: No pregnancy or breastfeeding uplift applies.

lines.question: Here are some popular goals. Which resonate with you?
lines.answer: Sleep, Heart Health, Bone & Joint Health
lines.changes: Decides which products are relevant at all, and brings the stimulant block into force through the sleep goal.

derived.changes: Derived from her height and weight, not asked. Governs the low-body-weight check and the energy requirement.

per_nutrient.source: Food plus modelled skin synthesis. The engine adds a sun credit to the same total, from her sun exposure answer, her skin tone, her country's latitude and the month, so this figure is not food alone.

steps.name: Gaps
steps.note: Vitamins and minerals are reported as coverage of her own target and stop at 100%, so a nutrient she already gets enough of reads as met rather than as a surplus. Nutrients that are ceilings rather than targets, free sugars and saturated fat among them, are not shortfalls when they sit below the figure and are not listed here.

steps.name: Scoring
steps.note: The engine gives a product no single score. It sorts the surviving products through the priority order below, tier by tier, and only compares the catalogue's own product rating when everything above is tied. So a fact about her always outranks a property of the catalogue. The catalogue rating is shown for each product below as what it is: the same number for every customer.

profile_limitations.asked_for: High blood pressure as the diagnosed condition
profile_limitations.engine: The quiz offers Cardiovascular Diseases and no narrower cardiac option, so that is what she answers. The products removed are the ones flagged against cardiovascular disease rather than against hypertension specifically.
The goal list offers Menopause and Hormonal Balance, with no perimenopause option, and three goals were already requested. No menopause goal was added, so nothing in this run is driven by one.
profile_limitations.used: Sleep, Heart Health, Bone & Joint Health

profile_limitations.asked_for: Eats fish one to two times a week
profile_limitations.engine: The food questions ask frequency in bands, from Never through to more than twice a day, and not in times per week. Sometimes is the band that covers once or twice a week.
profile_limitations.used: Sometimes, with oily and white fish selected

profile_limitations.asked_for: Three to four coffees a day
profile_limitations.engine: The quiz asks how many drinks other than water you have on a typical day, then which types, rather than counting coffees. Four drinks with coffee selected is the closest honest rendering.

profile_limitations.asked_for: A caffeine ceiling reacting to her coffee
profile_limitations.engine: The caffeine ceiling governs caffeine in the PRODUCTS only. The engine holds no caffeine figure for any food or drink, so her four coffees never enter the sum; a flat allowance for diet is subtracted from the daily total instead. What removed her green tea extract was the stimulant check, on her sleep goal and her short sleep.
profile_limitations.used: No caffeine ceiling exclusion in this run

profile_limitations.engine: The engine accepts a country and resolves the reference set from it, which is how this run is judged against United Kingdom requirements. profile_limitations.used: United Kingdom, supplied directly to the engine
